Strong: two clock beats, tick then a bigger tock, each with its own ring and pin kick. The package never moves.

icons.name: memory-chip
icons.heading: Memory chip
icons.description: The RAM module seats in its slot. Light: the module drives down until its contacts meet the slot and stops dead; the slot takes the hit, dips and settles while the module holds seated a beat, then it springs back up and settles. Strong: a short lift first, a harder drive that buries the contacts in the slot, a deeper slot dip with a rebound, then the release. The module stays rigid.

icons.heading: Ethernet
icons.description: The plug clicks home in its port. The drawing is the seated plug. Light: it eases back, drives up and stops dead on its seat; two click ticks flick out from the shoulders where it meets the port, and it rebounds once and settles. Strong: a deeper pull back, a harder drive, a bigger click, then a second smaller re-seat. The plug, contacts and cable move as one rigid piece.

icons.name: remote-control
icons.heading: Remote control
icons.description: A button press on the remote control sends a signal. Light: the power button at the top presses in and springs back, and an infrared signal of two arcs leaves the top of the remote, travels outward and fades. Strong: the remote tips forward to aim, the button is pressed twice, each press sends a signal, the second further, and the remote tips back and settles. The remote stays rigid.

icons.name: circuit-board
icons.heading: Circuit board
icons.description: Current runs through the circuit board. Light: the current enters each trace at the board's edge and runs along it to its pad, one trace after another, and each pad flashes as the current reaches it. Strong: two pulses run through the traces in turn, the second faster, and the pads flash twice, the second time bigger. The board never moves.
